arc.juncture_policy: SHORTER SEGMENTS, EARLY READS (the E1-E3 lesson: every arc peaked mid-arc and degraded at terminal dose): checkpoint at every u64 boundary (segment = 64 updates); a FAST gate read (Stage-B panel on 1 GPU + the GPU doc-NLL probe vs parent 3770621c + a fixed 24-episode execution slice) at EVERY u64 boundary while the next segment trains; FULL frozen gates at u128, u256 and the u512 cap; PROMOTION-OR-STOP AT THE BEST READING rather than a fixed terminal dose — stop at the first boundary showing the E3-u512 terminal-collapse signature (Stage-B valid < 11/14 while execution holds) or a doc-NLL regression above the parent band (+0.008 class) or any full-gate floor failure, promoting the best full-gate-quality checkpoint so far. Fail-closed: no automatic retries; no threshold changes.

evidence_basis.corpus_scale_rationale: The thin-film diagnosis: the programme's vision was ~1-2B post-train tokens; E1-E3 each trained ~450M-token preps at ~127M supervised targets and all three arcs failed the frozen gate with mid-arc peaks and terminal degradation — under-dosing is the standing hypothesis. E4 builds the corpus the vision asked for: 696,755,185 pool tokens / 336,770,673 supervised targets (2.65x E3 targets, 1.55x E3 tokens), inside the operator's 500M-1B+ band, entirely from already-admitted authorities at higher doses (standing-authorization class; NO new data sources). The human register — the thing that moved chat 0->2/3 — carries at 4.0x E3's dose: 80.0M real-human-chat targets (23.75%) + 19.6M fresh SmolTalk2 (5.82%) + the seam/session/teacher families. The anchors — the thing that held doc-NLL through 512 updates — carry at 175.0M targets (52.0%): mainmix 130M from the 36-window calibration superset (157.18M causal targets, kept on disk precisely to scale the mainmix share without new draws) + library fragments 45M of the 58.96M pool.
